Tumhein baahami muqaable kasrat-e-maal o aulaad ne ghaafil bana diya
Yahaan tak ke tum ne qabron se mulaaqaat kar li
Dekho tumhein anqareeb maaloom ho jaaega
Aur phir khoob maaloom ho jaaega
Dekho agar tumhein yaqeeni ilm ho jaata
Ke tum Jahannam ko zaroor dekhoge
Phir use apni aankhon dekhe yaqeen ki tarah dekhoge
Aur phir tum se us din ne'mat ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega
